description: Checks the check digit and structure of an identifier with no network call: ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 (with ISBN-10 to 13 conversion), EAN-8, UPC-A, EAN-13 and GTIN-14 (with the GS1 prefix country), VIN (manufacturer code, region, model year), IMEI, ISIN (country) and a generic Luhn number. type=auto detects the type. Up to 50 comma-separated values give a results array. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

type.description: auto (default), isbn, ean, vin, imei, isin or luhn

value.description: The identifier, or up to 50 comma-separated
